prompt: How to keep going when you're unmotivated
response: Feeling unmotivated can be tough, but it's important to remember that it's a normal part of the process. One way to overcome this is to break your goals down into smaller, more manageable tasks. This can make the task seem less daunting and more achievable. It's also a good idea to reward yourself for completing these smaller tasks, which can help maintain your motivation.
